newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope expresses condolences over Brazil crash.
newsitem.headline: Pope expresses condolences over Brazil crash.

text.p: Pope John Paul expressed his condolences on Friday to relatives of the victims of the crash of a Fokker-100 aircraft that killed up to 104 people in Brazil on Thursday.

In a telegram to Sao Paulo Archbishop Paul Evaristo Arns, the Pope expressed his "spiritual proximity and sincerest condolences" to relatives of the victims of flight 402, which ploughed into a neighbourhood in Brazil's largest city.
All 96 passengers and at least eight people on the ground were killed in the accident.
